newsitem.title: USA: Clintons take daughter Chelsea to birthday dinner.
newsitem.headline: Clintons take daughter Chelsea to birthday dinner.

text.p: Chelsea Clinton celebrated her 17th birthday on Thursday in relative low-key fashion, going to dinner with her parents and about 10 friends.
The big celebration of her birthday comes this weekend, when parents President Bill Clinton and Hillary Rodham Clinton take her to New York to see some shows.
"They're going to go up, they're going to take in some shows, they'll probably have some meals and have some fun. I think I'll leave it at that," White House spokesman Mike McCurry said.
During the day on Thursday Chelsea attended classes as usual at Sidwell Friends, an exclusive private school where she is in her senior year.
On Thurday night the Clintons and some of Chelsea's friends dined at the Bombay Club, complete with birthday cake, a few blocks from the White House.
In March she plans to accompany her mother on a tour of several African countries during her spring break from school.
White House officials familiar with her studies say she is showing an interest in taking pre-med classes when she starts college next autumn.
She has visited a variety of Ivy League schools, including Harvard, Brown and Yale, as well as Stanford in California.
The president has said Chelsea has not decided on a school in response to a Los Angeles Times report that she had been accepted by Harvard.
